top_signals.title: Joint Statement on the third EU-Türkiye High-Level Dialogue on Trade
top_signals.summary: European Commission Statement Brussels, 13 Oct 2026 The European Union and Türkiye held the 3rd EU-Türkiye High Level Dialogue on Trade on 13 October 2026 in Brussels. The meeting was co-chaired by the Commissioner for Trade and Economic Security, Interinstitutional Relations and Transparency Maroš Šefčovič and Minister of Trade of Türkiye Ömer Bolat.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.summary: "I think the public understands the need for discussions" on Japan's possession of a nuclear submarine, Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi said.
